Assistant panel (header-assistant-button) opens with greeting message and 3 preset questions, no credits text in the panel body. As Super Admin (manara.michele.pro@gmail.com): /piattaforma sidebar enumerates [Dashboard piattaforma, Gestione Utenti, Abbonamenti, Prenotazioni assistenza, Demo, Richieste demo, Marketplace, Modelli Pipeline, Messaggi, Novità, Supporto, Audit Log, Organizzatori, Email & Brevo, Social, Calendario editoriale, Impostazioni Social] - no 'Servizi e crediti' entry; /piattaforma page body does NOT contain 'crediti' nor 'Pagamenti e Crediti' block; /piattaforma/crediti direct URL redirects to '/' (route gone). Public pages: home '/', /registrati, /termini body texts contain NO 'crediti' word; /termini displays the renamed section 'Abbonamenti e funzionalità a pagamento'. Marketplace admin page body does NOT contain 'crediti'.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:11627 _charge_begin and :11691 credits_estimate have dead-code tails after the early return / hard-coded will_charge=False - safe to delete to shrink the file (~70 lines) and avoid confusing future readers.

backend/server.py:11060 credits_checkout: raise HTTPException 410 is correctly placed as the first statement, but the entire Stripe setup code (lines 11062-11210) after the raise is unreachable - consider deleting or guarding behind a feature flag.

The /profilo?tab=crediti URL currently shows the 'Il mio abbonamento' tab content but keeps the ?tab=crediti query string - minor UX nit: the frontend could rewrite the URL via history.replaceState to ?tab=abbonamento for consistency (not a bug).
